svg.title: Releases and pinning in neat-os
svg.desc: Work happens on develop. A release/X.Y.Z branch is cut from develop and merged into main by a person, who publishes the vX.Y.Z GitHub Release with changelog notes. Product repos pin a tag (or #develop for unreleased work), so several repos can sit on different tags: in the example, repo A is on v1.0.0, repo B on v1.1.0 and repo C on v1.2.0. A person moves a pin by hand: new tag, update the dependency, commit the lockfile. Grey cubes mark steps a person does.
